A '''subspace comm detector''' was a component used in [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech's]] [[ANq-51 sensor array computer/Legends|ANq-51 sensor array computer]]. Onboard the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'', the subspace comm detector was installed on the outer edge of the [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] [[Rectenna/Legends|rectenna]] dish.<ref name="EGWT" />
